protocol.scale_prior: Equal probability on declared discrete log-spaced grid; independent scale per track; shared across its train and held blocks
protocol.selection: All candidates already in each frozen proposal bank, no new scale-dependent top-four truncation. Banks were proposed at 100/200 Hz; full-catalogue completeness for other scales is not established.
protocol.phase: Qualified joint-source evaluation phases; unsupported dwell slots neutral; same earlier folds
protocol.baseline: Uniform +/-2m versus learned from other scan with identities, CFO scales and orbit times marginalized
protocol.meaning: Retrospective conditional predictive comparison, not independent identity truth
